criterion: Extracts a shared log-line parsing and severity-normalization helper in logwatch/analyzer.py used by both analyze_log_lines and filter_critical_events instead of duplicating string-splitting and field-conversion logic.

Decomposes analyze_log_lines into smaller, focused helper functions (such as per-service metric aggregation and service status/alert classification) with clear, descriptive variable and function names.
Extracts magic numbers and alert rules (severity alias mappings, error-rate thresholds 0.20 and 0.05, latency threshold 1000ms, HTTP 500 status cutoff, and 5xx count threshold) into named constants.
Preserves the public signatures and exact return structures of analyze_log_lines, filter_critical_events, and render_markdown_summary so all existing unit tests in tests/test_analyzer.py pass.
Adds unit tests in tests/ covering the extracted parsing or classification helpers and provides a clear summary of the refactorings performed.
